reasoning: This is the short-lived 2016-2018 Uber 'bit and atom' app icon: a rounded square enclosing a square path that terminates in a central circle. Because the brand retired this mark years ago, most users will not recognize it as rideshare and will instead read it as an RFID/NFC coil, maze, or keyhole; a car or taxi icon is far clearer for ride tasks.
